You will develop an understanding of business needs and objectives through basic descriptive, predictive, and prescriptive models. You will regularly connect with colleagues and stakeholders to understand priorities and communicate findings. This is a developing role with a basic skill set, working under close supervision with some latitude for problem solving within existing data platforms and tools.
cond_0312.responsibilities:
Design, develop, and evaluate basic/routine predictive models and algorithms with some complexity
Analyze and interpret results with some complexity, and walk team members through your findings
Limited judgment and discretion within defined procedures and practices
Develop and code basic software programs, algorithms, and automated processes
Use modeling and trend analysis to analyze data
Actively collaborate with team members and contribute to team projects and initiatives, staying in regular contact throughout
Use clear written and verbal communication to document and present findings to colleagues
cond_0312.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
3 To 5 years of experience in exploratory data analysis
Hands-on working experience with Python, SQL, R, Hadoop, SAS, SPSS, Scala, or AWS
Statistics, programming, data modeling, simulation, and mathematics
Bachelor's Degree in Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Engineering, or a similar quantitative field
Model lifecycle execution
Technical writing
Problem solving (responds as problems and issues are identified)
Interpersonal skills and ability to communicate clearly with team members
Critical thinking

Master's Degree in Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, or Engineering
